title: Versioned rayx releases: cargo-dist builds for six targets, release-plz automation, v1.0.0, installers into ~/.rayx/bin, WSL and RayX CI on the release

checks.descriptionMarkdown: New group `tests/release_config.rs`: parses `dist-workspace.toml` (dist version, six targets, installers, checksum, install path list, attestations, the Windows ARM64 custom runner and host, `pr-run-mode`, no `allow-dirty`) and checks `release.yml` (tag trigger, no container on the Windows ARM64 entry is dist's output, so assert on the config and the generated header/dist version only).

`dist plan` with dist 0.33.0 on PATH (install it into a scratch or user tool directory before the sprint; it is an external tool, so the result is not reused). Fails when the generated CI is out of date with the config.

New group `tests/release_automation.rs`: `release-plz.toml` keys and changelog configuration, the tag template agreeing with dist's trigger and `src/setup/wsl.rs`'s `v{version}` URL, `release-plz.yml` structure (trigger, repository guard, two jobs, `fetch-depth: 0`, `RELEASE_PLZ_TOKEN` as the only secret, used for checkout and `GITHUB_TOKEN`), `Cargo.toml` version at least 1.0.0 and a `CHANGELOG.md` section for it.
AgentX's workflow YAML checker (duplicate keys GitHub rejects) over the release workflows. The script path is the installed AgentX skill's; adjust it to the local install when resolving the sprint.

New group `tests/dependency_sources.rs`: the rule function on inline accept/reject manifests (registry, pinned git `rev`, `branch`/`tag`/unpinned git, `path`, `rayx-ui/RayX`, `[patch]` with and without an upstream-link comment, `[replace]`) and on the real `Cargo.toml` and `cargo metadata`.

New group `tests/wsl_install.rs` with the scripted runner: versioned installer URL piped to `sh` through `--exec bash -lc`, `$HOME/.rayx/bin/rayx` for the version probe and the inner `setup`, no reinstall of a matching version, the unsupported-architecture message before any download, `RAYX_WSL_BINARY` copied to `~/.rayx/bin`, nothing run in print mode.
`cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings`, as CI runs it: the new test groups and `src/setup/wsl.rs` must be warning-free.

Every group the epic adds plus the existing groups that exercise touched code: `package_layout` (dependency checks moved out, README assertions), `wsl_plan` (the WSL install path and URL changed), `cli_surface` (`--version` after the 1.0.0 bump). Not the whole suite: the epic touches release configuration, one setup module and tests.
The changed RayX workflow parses without duplicate keys (AgentX's checker; adjust the script path to the local install).

sprints.title: Release build configuration, proven on hosted runners for all six targets

tasks.title: dist 0.33.0 configuration and regenerated release workflow
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: Install dist 0.33.0 locally (official release archive for this host into a user tool directory; not committed). In `dist-workspace.toml` set `cargo-dist-version = "0.33.0"`, `install-path = ["$RAYX_HOME/bin", "~/.rayx/bin"]`, `github-attestations = true`, `pr-run-mode = "upload"` and `[dist.github-custom-runners.aarch64-pc-windows-msvc]` with `runner = "windows-2022"`, `host = "x86_64-pc-windows-msvc"`; keep targets, installers, checksum, `install-updater = false`, `hosting`. Run `dist generate` and commit the regenerated `release.yml` (inspect the diff: Windows ARM64 entry without the cargo-xwin container, attestation steps present, tag trigger unchanged). Confirm in dist's output or docs how the `~/.rayx/bin` mode names the Unix env script and that the receipt path stays `rayx-cli` (`src/update.rs` `APP_NAME`). Write `tests/release_config.rs`.

tasks.title: Prove the release build of all six targets on a pull request
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: With the owner's confirmation, push the epic branch (e.g. `feature/releases`) and open a draft pull request against `main`; later sprints push to the same PR. Watch the Release workflow's `build-local-artifacts` jobs; download the artifacts into an ignored `artifacts-temp/agentx/rayx-cli-releases/` directory and confirm the archive set, the `.sha256` files, both installers, an ARM64 PE `rayx.exe` and static musl binaries. On a Windows ARM64 failure, record the log excerpt as a finding and follow `d-dist-release-build`'s fallback order through a specification amendment (the axoasset step needs the dependency rule of sprint s3 first).

sprints.title: release-plz, version 1.0.0, changelog and release docs

tasks.title: release-plz configuration and workflow
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: Add `release-plz.toml` (git-only, tag `v{{ version }}`, no GitHub Release, changelog on, semver check off, no publish, git-cliff `[changelog]` with Conventional Commit groups and `## [X.Y.Z] - YYYY-MM-DD` headings that dist's parser reads; skip `chore(agentx)` and `chore(release)` commits). Add `.github/workflows/release-plz.yml` per RPZ-2, using the current `release-plz/action` major with its `command: release` and `command: release-pr` jobs, `RELEASE_PLZ_TOKEN` for checkout and `GITHUB_TOKEN`, and the toolchain from `rust-toolchain.toml`. Check release-plz's docs for how `git_only` treats a history with no tag (initial release) and record the answer in `docs/releasing.md` (t05). Write `tests/release_automation.rs` (a crates.io YAML dev-dependency is acceptable for parsing the workflow).

tasks.title: Version 1.0.0 and the first changelog section
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: Set `version = "1.0.0"` in `Cargo.toml`, update `Cargo.lock` (`cargo update -p rayx-cli --offline` or a build), and write `CHANGELOG.md` with a header and a hand-written `## [1.0.0]` section summarizing the first release. Extend `tests/release_automation.rs` with the version/changelog invariant of RPZ-3.

tasks.title: README install section and docs/releasing.md
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: Write `docs/releasing.md` (RPZ-4) and rework the README install section (DOC-1). Keep the README strings `tests/package_layout.rs` asserts. Also update `docs/manual-verification.md`'s "Not verifiable before a release" note to point at the s5 checklist.

tasks.title: Relax the dependency rule and enforce it in its own test group
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: Move the registry-only assertions out of `tests/package_layout.rs` (`assert_registry_only` and the `[patch]`/`[replace]` checks) into the new `tests/dependency_sources.rs` with a rule function per DEP-1, tested on inline sample manifests and the real manifest. Update `CLAUDE.md` and `AGENTS.md` identically per DEP-2 (Layout bullet on dependencies, the intro sentence about private siblings). Memory rules are synced at epic promotion, not here.

sprints.title: WSL installs the Linux rayx with the release installer

tasks.title: Versioned installer into ~/.rayx/bin inside the distribution
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: In `src/setup/wsl.rs` change `LINUX_BINARY` to `$HOME/.rayx/bin/rayx`, replace the archive download/extract script with the versioned installer piped to `sh` (non-interactive; confirm the dist shell installer's flags, e.g. quiet mode, from the generated `rayx-cli-installer.sh` of sprint s1's build), keep the version probe, the architecture pre-check and the `RAYX_WSL_BINARY` copy (to `~/.rayx/bin`). Remove `release_asset` only if nothing needs it any more. Write `tests/wsl_install.rs` and update the `tests/wsl_plan.rs` assertions on the old path and archive URL.

sprints.title: Publish v1.0.0, verify installs on real hosts, move RayX CI to the release

tasks.title: Merge the epic and publish v1.0.0 through release-plz
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: Owner prerequisite: `RELEASE_PLZ_TOKEN` exists. With the owner's go-ahead, mark the epic PR ready and merge it (after its CI and Release-build runs are green). Follow release-plz: review and merge the release PR (its CI must run), watch the tag push and the Release workflow, then check `gh release view v1.0.0` and `gh attestation verify` per FIRST-1. Use the by-hand tag fallback only if release-plz cannot cut the first release, and record why.

tasks.title: Install v1.0.0 on real hosts and in WSL
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: On this Mac run the macOS one-liner; have the owner run the Windows one-liner and `rayx setup --wsl` on their PC; cover Linux x64 in WSL or a container. Check FIRST-2 and WSL-2 and record the results (versions, paths, PATH resolution, `self update --check`) in `docs/manual-verification.md`.

tasks.title: RayX CI and docs install the pinned v1.0.0 release
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: In `../RayX`, on a new branch from its default branch `master` (not the current `fix/ios-simulator-run`), change `.github/workflows/pr-test.yml` and `docs/src/rayx.md` per FIRST-3 and sync the RayX memory decision text about the pin. Commit with a Conventional Commit naming the RayX.CLI release; with the owner's confirmation push and open the PR, and confirm both jobs pass.
